scope: Controlled overlay metadata/selection/preset policy with mixer/storage collaborators; no actual DOM/GPU/assets/hardware/native/vendor acceptance.

checks.name: Select text/image independently without enabling or modifying their content
Continuous overlay values clamp their real independent ranges and address only selected kind
Animation selection and documented option labels change actual metadata
Move delegates resource ownership and preserves the selected overlay identity
Image enable refuses absent decoded bytes and does not claim a visible overlay
Save/select/load a text preset restores content without replacing overlay identity
Image metadata preset reload clears owned decoded bytes and stays off until reimport
Empty selections, malformed values and unknown actions do not create hidden placeholders
Storage failure retains overlay contents and pending preset selection
Snapshot and restore preserve selected overlay identity and preset name safely
